name: DividedSplitting.stdClassSum_inner_productForm_eq_zero
summary: An instance of stdClassSum_period_eq_zero with C = Cartan product with y (conjugated), whose hypotheses are checked: equivariance of the Cartan product, the places of M², the support of γ_L, and the level K(ϖ).

steps.claim: Apply stdClassSum_period_eq_zero with ε = V.ε, Y the inclusion matrices of O.incl, 𝔪 = M² and C = (cartanProduct V.ε 1 y) ∘ conjugation.
steps.lean:
stdClassSum_period_eq_zero hO hQ hM h0 hH hn V.ε (fun _ ↦ inclMatrix_mulVecLin_injective ..) (𝔪 :=
  O.chosenModulusSq) (cartanProduct V.ε 1 y ∘ₛₗ (starLinearEquiv ℂ).1) (fun g u ζ h ↦ by
    simp [conjWeylRep, weylRep_cartanProduct, V.low, HasColumnsBelow]
    simp [cartanProduct, weylRep, star_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose, conjTranspose_transpose,
      V.low.2.schur_mul_schur, ← map_inv, by simpa using (U.form_mul_inv_eq <| g ·)]
    congr! 6 <;> simp [h, entrywise, reindex_equiv V.ε]) (by simp [places_levelModulus_false])
  L.mem_supportedOn (by tauto) rfl fun k
  q ↦ have ⟨m, s⟩ := map_block_eq_blockGL O.chosenModulusSq.reduction V.ε 1 k; by
    simp_all [Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff t,
      Modulus.reductionK₀]; peel L.reduceAt_conj_eq_one _ s; simp [*]

steps.claim: Its hypothesis hC: the Cartan product with y is equivariant for block-diagonal g = diag(1, u) (weylRep_cartanProduct, the column conditions V.low, Schur matrices of products: schur_mul_schur, unitarity U.form_mul_inv_eq); and h𝔪: the places of M² are the chosen places (places_levelModulus_false).
steps.lean:
simp [conjWeylRep, weylRep_cartanProduct, V.low, HasColumnsBelow]
    simp [cartanProduct, weylRep, star_mulVec, ← mulVec_transpose, conjTranspose_transpose,
      V.low.2.schur_mul_schur, ← map_inv, by simpa using (U.form_mul_inv_eq <| g ·)]
    congr! 6 <;> simp [h, entrywise, reindex_equiv V.ε]) (by simp [places_levelModulus_false])

steps.claim: The point γ_L is supported on the chosen places (L.mem_supportedOn), e' factors as required, and every k in K(ϖ) satisfies hk: diag(1, k) reduces to the block matrix (map_block_eq_blockGL), k ≡ 1 modulo M² (mem_principalLevel_iff with t), so γ_L⁻¹·diag(1,k)·γ_L reduces to 1 at the chosen places (DividedLattice.reduceAt_conj_eq_one).
steps.lean:
L.mem_supportedOn (by tauto) rfl fun k
  q ↦ have ⟨m, s⟩ := map_block_eq_blockGL O.chosenModulusSq.reduction V.ε 1 k; by
    simp_all [Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff t,
      Modulus.reductionK₀]; peel L.reduceAt_conj_eq_one _ s; simp [*]
